[PREFERENCE] User is interested in trying out Yin Yoga.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for getting started with Yin Yoga: understand the basics, find a quiet space, invest in props, start slow, listen to the body, and focus on breath.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested online resources and YouTube channels for Yin Yoga: Yin Yoga with Bernie Clark, Yin Yoga with Paulie Zink, Dylan Werner Yoga, Yoga With Adriene, Fightmaster Yoga, Yin Yoga with Sarah Powers.

[PREFERENCE] User wants to incorporate more Yin Yoga into their practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips on sequencing a Yin Yoga practice: start with a clear intention, begin with a gentle warm-up, target areas of tension, balance yin and yang postures, hold postures for 3-5 minutes, use props wisely, and end with a gentle cool-down.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed common mistakes to avoid in Yin Yoga: forcing or pushing, not listening to the body, holding postures for too long, not using props correctly, not breathing deeply, practicing too frequently, and not respecting the body's boundaries.
